title: Concepts In Wood 84" Traditional Triple Wide Wood Bookcase with 15 Adjustable Shelves & 3 Fixed Shelves, Assembly Required, for Laundry/Bedroom/Kitchen/Garage/Office, in Cherry Finish

reviews.title: Just assembled, and loaded with books, our third one!
reviews.body: First off, I agree the instructions may be a bit murky in spots, but any mistakes during assembly are easily remedied by easy dis-assembly followed by reassembly (thoroughly tested that part out). Our second and third bookcases went together without any do overs. We purchased the three bookcases over three years, one each year. Quality has always been first rate. Just for everyone's information, three years ago, the entire kit was shipped in a single box. Pity the person delivering that package! Two boxes are a big improvement.The instructions have stayed exactly the same during this time, so no use complaining about that in your review. Think of the instructions as, well, just guidelines. You will need to use a bit of smarts to figure the puzzle out.Once assembled, and loaded with items, especially books, these bookshelves do look very good. Shelf height is easily adjusted. The whole piece is very sturdy, no sagging shelves what-so-ever.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 9, 2025
reviews.author: Kirk

reviews.title: Great finish, but THE PIECES ARENT LABLED!
reviews.body: This bookcase is beautiful and VERY HEAVY!  I am usually very skeptical of reviews, so when I read all the reviews saying it was heavy and hard to put together because of poor directions and unlabeled pieces, I was very skeptical. Most people don’t read or follow directions very well, so I chalked it up to that!I should’ve listened- yet, I’m glad I didn’t because likely wouldn’t have bought the case and wouldn’t have the beautiful bookcase I do now!  However, the reviews are accurate! The pieces are very heavy, and generally not labeled.  I found the directions to be pretty clear - pieces not being labeled makes assembly a lot longer. I put it together by myself too- because I’m stubborn and don’t have patience to wait on other people to help! lol! Don’t be like me- 2 to 3 people working together can make this go a lot faster.  It took me about 4 hours to get everything put together by myself-just to give you a sense of how much there is to do.  Pro tip;  get yourself an impact driver with some Phillips screwdriver bits.  Assembly will go faster if you don’t have to manually screw everything! Another good piece of advice is to make sure you assemble this in a setting with lots of space NEAR where you are going to place the bookcase- it’s super heavy when fully assembled and you won’t be able to move it up and down stairs at all without taking it apart-unless you have abnormally wide and tall staircases.I think it is worth the money to purchase it. I gave it 4 stars because of the unlabeled pieces and because the back piece of the bookcase is not wood, but rather some weird piece of vinyl. I don’t like that part, but it’ll work for now.  I love the finished product and I now have lots more book storage capacity!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 22, 2025
reviews.author: Wordlover

reviews.title: Nice looking, well built and good value
reviews.body: The bookcase looks very nice and well built.  It's a good value for under $600.  I saw similar bookcases selling for over $900 elsewhere.  It came in two boxes, which need 2 people to bring inside.  Installation is not easy, but a lot of fun.  It took me almost 5 hours to put the pieces together.  People complained about the instruction manual is not clear.  I found it not true.  The step-by-step instruction is clear and just needs to be read carefully.  The bookcase is very sturdy once installed.  It is very heavy (over 200 lbs) and requires two people to move it, or you can put furniture pads at the bottom and then slide push to the position.  Make sure that you secure it to the wall at the top to prevend tipping with the included hardware.  Overall, I am very pleased with the bookcase and would definitely recommend it.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 6, 2023
reviews.author: Kevin L.

reviews.title: Just one suggestion
reviews.body: The shelves are well packaged, yet arrived slightly damaged. The vertical boards are 84" tall and when they are shipped under no circumstances should these panels be laying flat in a way so the panels can be bend. This breaks off the trim, as it happened in my case. The boxes should have a label to be stored or shipped in a way that no force can bend the side panels. lets say the shipping boxes are 100" * 20" * 6* (approximately), then the 100*6" side should be pointing upwards... NOT the 100*20" side.Otherwise in the world of fiber board furniture with veneer... these are the better quality. The shelves look great and there is attention to detail, especially, the back is SCREWED on (lots of screws)... not nailed as in cheaper furniture. This is most important, because nails into these fiber-boards do not hold ever and the back panel is required to keep the shelf square.This shelf is strong enough so I can climb on top of it (200lbs)... do not try this with some cheaper furniture of this kind

reviews.title: Not for an impatient person
reviews.body: It’s nice however I’m stuck with assembling. The instructions do not match the pieces and the pieces are NOT LABELED. You need extreme patience and logic to pit this together. Do not purchase if you fly off the handle quickly!My permanent shelves (3) 2 of them did not come pre drilled and I do not have a drill bit to drill holes big enough. This is a major frustration! Now I’m at a standstill and this large half put together bookshelf is taking up space in my townhouse. I have to wait for the company to get back and hopefully send me the two shelves that are predrilled. This should not happen. What happened to quality control?

reviews.title: Beautiful shelves
reviews.body: Absolutely love this bookshelf.  I needed something taller and ran out of room on my smaller bookcases.This bookshelf is absolutes gorgeous, but is is a little heavy.  I was able to put it together myself, but needs help to get it up off the floor and into place.Once it is put together, it is very sturdy.  One of the shelves arrived with a “broken” lip, but it was otherwise undamaged.  Rather than contacting the company for a replacement shelf, I just glued the piece on, and it’s been holding steady.Very good quality.  Arrived in 2 very heavy packages.

reviews.title: Nice unit for the price, see review regarding assembly
reviews.body: Very nice unit for the price.  Assembly instructions are not 100% accurate, but if you pay attention you should be ok.Some examples:1.  Step 1 says to insert 6 dowels into each divider, but it’s actually 9 per.  The holes are predrilled and there are 3 in each spot.2.  Step 4 notes 3 dowels per piece (top & bottom), but it should be 6 per, again 3 per location.3.  Step 6:  the picture does not show the cam holes in both dividers, but both dividers should be in the same direction during this step (with the long dowels towards the bottom piece).Few tips to keep in mind:1.  you are installing from the back of the unit, so do it on carpet, a rug or blanket.2.  If you can, flip the page once you start the actual assembly so the bottom will be where you are placing the unit.  Then you’ll only need to flip it up and not move it far.3.  I would recommend a plastic handle screwdriver as there are a ton of screws (the back is screwed on, not nailed like most).  Rubber screwdriver gives you a nice palm blister.Finally, there are not 15 adjustable shelves, but 12 (4 per section).  The next to bottom shelf in the picture is fixed and the other 3 shelves are the bottom of the unit.  So it is 18 shelves (6 per section), but only 12 are adjustable.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on August 27, 2023

features: Handcrafted bookshelf furniture using genuine wood veneers and solid wood molding that enhances durability and won’t crack or peel like paper laminates.
70lb weight capacity per shelf to accommodate a large collection of books
10 step polyurethane Cherry finish that is durable, beautiful, and resists stains for years, environmentally friendly zero VOC emissions
All wood veneers, panels, solid hardwood wood, and other materials are sourced from the U.S.A.
Quick, simple assembly with dowels, camlocks and an engineered wood back panel that is more durable than the cardboard on most ready to assemble bookcases
15 adjustable shelves to allow for maximum storage, 3 fixed shelves, Dimensions: 84" H x 72" W x 10.625" D
